name: rubber bearings
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 以橡胶材料提供承载、弹性支承及耗能作用的支座。
usage_overview: 在浮置板轨道隔振分析中用作点式隔振支承，其黏弹性及支承参数的随机性是分析传递力特征、评价隔振性能时关注的因素。

complete_examples.text: In this work, a stochastic fractional derivative model is proposed for simulating the dynamic behavior of rubber bearings in floating slab tracks.
It considers the viscoelastic characteristics of the rubber bearings, as well as randomness in mechanical behavior due to manufacturing tolerances, aging, and fatigue.

P021.title: Investigation of the vibration isolation performance of floating slab track with rubber bearings using a stochastic fractional derivative model
